name: Love Guru
overview: This is a story about a young, attractive woman named Sonali and a man named Mohan. Sonali unintentionally moves to the house next to Mohan’s and the two of them begin making out. Due to their intense love for one another and inability to sleep at night, they both desire to arrive at their Final Destination.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Nidhi introduces Rohan, her boyfriend to her mother, Mallika. But, when Mallika meets Rohan, she also falls for him. And out of guilt she rejects Rohan. Now, Mallika is in shambles, between her sexual desieres and the motherly responsibilities, until she decides to call Love Guru and ask his help to get out of such convoluted situation

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Mini, a young college student faces difficulty in the matters of heart as she starts developing feelings for her professor, Varun. She calls Love Guru seeking advice on how to exhibit her feelings for Varun and Love Guru plays cupid as he brings the two together!
